summary: Implementation plan for rebranding ClassHub 3-B to 'いちはちさいと' (1-8 SITE) and reconstructing the UI with a creative modern academic festival style inspired by marugotosai.jp (神山まるごと高専 まるごと祭). Preserves all existing features (anonymous grade rankings, weekly quizzes, PDF/JPG exam paper viewers, class forum, and /edit editor) while infusing vibrant high-school festival aesthetics, dynamic tickers, and an intuitive layout.
